premise: A drizzle comes; Mushroom stretches her cap to make room for Ladybug and Butterfly, and they tell stories until the rain stops.
inspiration: The Mitten (Ukrainian folk tale), turned: the shelter never bursts, it stretches, and the squeeze is the cosy part.
lesson: There is always room for one more friend.

en-US.title: Mushroom's Shelter
en-US.text: {canvas:rain 0.35 45s} {sfx:drizzle} Plip. Plop. A drizzle began. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} ran under Mushroom's cap. [excited] Can I come in? Of course, said Mushroom {mushroom:pulse}. Plip, plop. Then Butterfly {butterfly:float} fluttered down, with damp wings. [sad] Is there room for me? Mushroom looked at her cap. It was small. [softly] Let's see, she said. And she stretched {mushroom:glow} her cap as wide as it would go. Ladybug scooted over. Butterfly folded her wings. [giggles] Squeeze, squeeze… just right! Under the cap it was dry and cosy. Ladybug told a story about the stars. Butterfly told a story about the sea. Plip… plop… plip. [whispers] And they were having so much fun that nobody noticed when the rain stopped. {mushroom:hearts} {ladybug:hearts} {butterfly:hearts}

es-ES.title: El refugio de Seta
es-ES.text: {canvas:rain 0.35 45s} {sfx:drizzle} Plic. Ploc. Empezó a chispear. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} corrió debajo del sombrero de Seta. [excited] ¿Puedo entrar? Claro que sí, dijo Seta {mushroom:pulse}. Plic, ploc. Luego bajó Mariposa {butterfly:float} revoloteando, con las alas mojadas. [sad] ¿Hay sitio para mí? Seta miró su sombrero. Era pequeño. [softly] A ver, dijo. Y estiró {mushroom:glow} su sombrero todo lo que pudo. Mariquita se hizo a un lado. Mariposa plegó las alas. [giggles] Apretadita, apretadita… ¡justo! Debajo del sombrero se estaba seco y calentito. Mariquita contó un cuento sobre las estrellas. Mariposa contó un cuento sobre el mar. Plic… ploc… plic. [whispers] Y se lo estaban pasando tan bien que nadie se dio cuenta de que ya no llovía. {mushroom:hearts} {ladybug:hearts} {butterfly:hearts}

drizzle.prompt: a light drizzle pattering softly on a mushroom cap and leaves
